description: Canadair Sabre Mk 6, construction number 1643, in Luftwaffe markings JB+110. It was an exhibit of the Luftwaffenmuseum while that museum was at Uetersen and stayed behind when the collection moved to Berlin-Gatow in 1995; it now stands in the airfield car park with its engine removed.
